subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: Where the authority forces ("panel this") or waives ("skip the panel") the panel move, the skill shall honor the override and record it with the authority's reason.
rationale: the rule is a default, not a cage; the override is itself provenance (#D-4)
fit_criterion: override fixtures: forced-on-extension runs the panel; waived-on-new-seam skips it; both audit notes present with reasons
